purpose: Make the already-registered ordered_lagged_returns_and_levels representation executable without changing labels, horizons, outer folds, method universe, metrics, thresholds, or selection rules.

scope.transformations: Only training-fold StandardScaler; fit its means and scales using training rows in the current fold. No global scaling, imputation from future rows, PCA, feature selection, or feature engineering fit on the full sample.

intraday.decision_rows: Eligible minute-aligned SPOT observations within a pinned regular NSE session.
intraday.history: For lookback L, the feature vector contains L simple returns and L close levels. Return j is close[t-j] / close[t-j-1] - 1 for j=0..L-1; level j is close[t-j] for j=0..L-1. Feature values use the decision bar and up to L previous one-minute transitions, all within the same session; at least L+1 exact eligible closes are required.
intraday.target: Use an exact observed close at decision timestamp + the registered horizon in minutes. Decision and endpoint must both be in the same regular session; do not interpolate, forward-fill, or use a different timestamp.
intraday.flat_rule: Exclude and count rows whose absolute simple return is <= 1e-8; y=1 only if return > 1e-8, otherwise y=0 when return < -1e-8.
intraday.endpoint_session_index: Equal to the decision exchange-session index.

positional.decision_rows: Exact SPOT close observation timestamped 15:30:00 on each eligible official NSE session.
positional.history: For lookback L, use the decision session close and up to L immediately preceding official exchange-session closes. Feature vector contains L simple close-to-close returns and L close levels, both ordered newest-to-oldest. All L+1 source closes must exist; do not fill missing session closes.
positional.target: Use the exact observed close at session-index i+h, where h is the registered number of complete following official exchange sessions. Do not use calendar-day offsets or forward-fill.
positional.flat_rule: Exclude and count rows whose absolute simple return is <= 1e-8; y=1 only if return > 1e-8, otherwise y=0 when return < -1e-8.
positional.endpoint_session_index: Decision exchange-session index + registered positional horizon.

point_in_time_and_quarantine.option_rows_are_features: Not in this initial PM0001 spot-only representation. Option-derived or global/contextual features require a separate pre-result feature contract with PIT publication/availability verification.
point_in_time_and_quarantine.duplicate_timestamps: Do not deduplicate by value equality in this builder. Any duplicate eligible SPOT timestamp fails closed; source-level byte-identical deduplication is governed by the frozen preprocessing rules.
point_in_time_and_quarantine.timestamp_and_price: Require parseable IST timestamps, exact whole-minute alignment, finite positive nifty_close, and session_date matching the timestamp's local date for an eligible observation.
point_in_time_and_quarantine.quarantined_rows: Ignore rows outside the frozen regular-session/calendar eligibility domain and count them in aggregate diagnostics; never use them as features or targets.
point_in_time_and_quarantine.target_maturity: Every training/calibration target endpoint must be observable strictly before the relevant training cutoff; target labels are not feature values.
point_in_time_and_quarantine.holdout: No holdout data path or secret may be read.

non_changes: No changes to target definitions, the 10 registered horizons, fold calendar boundaries, purge/embargo values, support minima, missingness limit, statistical metrics, multiplicity correction, method compatibility decisions, or strategy-selection scope.
This supplement defines the pre-result mechanical interpretation of an already-registered feature representation; it is not evidence that PM0001 is eligible or authorized for fitting.
